segments.contextAfter: `scale = 1` for `scaling_mode = none`, `scale = 1/V_f` for `scaling_mode = size`, `scale = 1/sqrt(V_f)` for `scaling_mode = unitary`, where `V_f` is the volume of the transformation defined by the dimensions included in `axes` (`V_f = prod_{i \in axes} shape(input)[i]`) (see [`scalingMode`](mpsgraphfftdescriptor/scalingmode.md)), `+` is selected in `+/-` when `inverse` is specified, otherwise `-` is used and the sum is done separately over each dimension in `axes` and `n` is the dimension length of that axis.
